question.text: Aqueous solutions of $\mathrm{HNO}_3, \mathrm{KOH}$, $\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{COOH}$, and $\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{COONa}$ of identical concentrations are provided. The pair(s) of solutions which form a buffer upon mixing is(are)

solution.text:
$\mathrm{HNO}_3$ and $\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{COONa}$ can form buffer if the amount of $\mathrm{HNO}_3$ is limited. However concentrations are same but the amount can differ with manipulation of volume.
